form.label: Job search
form.description: Applications and saved jobs are activity records. The export does not contain reliable interview, rejection or offer outcomes.

search.query: index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:* earliest=0 latest=+10y | search member_id=* | stats count BY member_id | eval member_label=if(member_id="personal","Personal",member_id) | fields member_id member_label

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | dedup export_id | sort - import_epoch | eval label=snapshot_time." — ".status | fields label export_id
index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | dedup export_id | sort - import_epoch | head 1 | fields export_id

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | dedup export_id | table snapshot_time snapshot_time_basis status actual_records warning_count export_id

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=job_application time_basis=activity | timechart span=1mon count AS Applications

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=saved_job time_basis=activity | timechart span=1mon count AS Saved

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=job_application | stats count AS Applications BY company | sort - Applications | head 20

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=job_application | stats count AS Applications BY job_title | sort - Applications | head 20

panel.title: Applications also present in saved jobs

search.query: `li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset IN (job_application,saved_job) | where job_url!="" | stats values(dataset) AS datasets values(company) AS company values(job_title) AS job_title BY job_url | where mvcount(datasets)=2 | table company job_title job_url

`li_records` | search member_id=$member|s$ | where export_id=if($snapshot|s$="latest",$latest_export|s$,$snapshot|s$) | search dataset=job_application | sort - _time | table application_date company job_title job_url
